entities.name: Garna
entities.description: Battle-scarred Keldon warrior and rival of Radha who leads a violent, xenophobic warhost.

entities.name: Radha
entities.description: Keldon Grand Warlord and Garna's rival.

entities.name: Second Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which Garna set aside her rivalry with Radha.

events.summary: After the Second Phyrexian Invasion, Garna agreed to set aside her rivalry with Radha to work together against Phyrexia.
events.quote: Garna has agreed to set aside her rivalry with Radha
